verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Browser Use publishes an llms.txt at docs.browser-use.com (HTTP 200). It indexes both the Cloud Agent/Browser API docs and the open-source Python library docs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and first-party documentation describing the llms.txt offering and how complete its coverage is.
